background_image_description: The image displays a pattern of vertical stripes in alternating shades of gray and white. The stripes are of equal width and run perfectly vertically from the top to the bottom of the image, creating a consistent and repetitive design. The background color is a uniform light gray, providing a neutral backdrop for the stripes. No other elements, text, or objects are visible in the image. The stripes are evenly spaced and of the same length, contributing to the overall uniformity of the pattern.
